source_conflicts.description: The program text (hesbernosaf) names 11 specialization areas (מערכות מחשב, תקשורת, בקרה ומערכות אוטונומיות, עיבוד אותות, התקנים אלקטרוניים, אלקטרואופטיקה ופוטוניקה, אלקטרומגנטיות וקרינה, אנרגיה ומקורות מתחדשים, תקשורות ואינפורמציה קוונטית, ביו-אלקטרוניקה, חומרים); the program tree has 14 track sections (adds VLSI, machine learning/AI and multidisciplinary, and names some differently). The spec follows the tree's track sections.
Advanced-labs hours: the Year-4 section says 6-8 ש"ס, the years 3-4 section says 5-8 ש"ס (both 3-6.5 weighted). The spec states no lab hours (category advanced_labs: min_courses 2).

The overlap note on 0512-4506 names "מבוא לאלקטרניקת הספק 05124506" - its own number; the course called מבוא לאלקטרוניקת הספק on the same page is 0512-4507. Not resolved; see course_rules[excl-0512-4506-as-printed].
IMS 2026 lists 0510-6404 as offered (semester A) but the program timetable has no group for it. The spec keeps it (IMS).

The program page lists these courses without the cancelled flag, but IMS 2026 says not offered and the program timetable has no group: 0510-7400, 0510-7438, 0510-7650, 0512-4262, 0512-4364, 0512-4493, 0512-4507, 0555-4000, 0581-4321, 0581-5312. The spec follows IMS + timetable and leaves them out of the elective pools (not plannable in תשפ"ז); 0512-4262 is also marked core (see course_rules[core-four-distinct-tracks]).

course_rules.note: TAU: 12 track courses over the degree (labs excluded), of which at least 4 are marked "קורס ליבה" and come from 4 different tracks. The core marking exists only in each listing's course note ("קורס ליבה במסלול X"; the listing data has no core field) and is attributed to the track the note names, not the section it is listed under (e.g. 0512-4264 is listed in 5 tracks, core of ml_ai only; 0512-4601 is core of optics_photonics and bioelectronics). Core courses not taught in תשפ"ז (IMS not_offered): 0512-4262, 0555-4551. Nothing enforces this: the board has no core marking, and the 12-course minimum lives only in group_minimums.track (spec_to_program emits only the 'core' group to the board as core_courses_total_min), so the planner checks neither. Update: the generic track-course minimum is now carried in group_minimums.track and enforced by the builder and planner. The distinct-track core requirement in this rule remains unenforced.

TAU: 2 advanced labs from 2 different tracks; a student who takes both in the same track must take a third lab in another track, whose credits do not count toward the theoretical-course credits. category_members keys are the track categories; the labs themselves sit in the advanced_labs category (min_courses 2). The board enforces only the count of 2 (category advanced_labs), not the distinct-track condition nor the third-lab rule.

course_rules.note: TAU engineering regulations (Terms_BA.pdf p1): the normal format is a full program and the student may set their own pace, but studying less than 75% of a full load needs a request to the track head. The boards carry no load bounds (semester total_weekly_hours is informational only).

nine_semester_programs: הנדסה מכנית ומדעי כדור הארץ בהדגש לימודי סביבה

course_rules.note: TAU engineering regulations (Terms_BA.pdf p1): the bachelor's degree lasts eight semesters (four years); the nine-semester (4.5-year) exception names the double programs ME+Marine Biotechnology, ME+Earth Sciences (environment) and Materials+Chemistry, not this single-major program (whose program page lists years א-ד). Enforced by the boards: data/boards/electrical_engineering_years_1_2_2027.json semesters[].semester_id = year_1_semester_a..year_2_semester_b and data/boards/electrical_engineering_2027.json semesters[].semester_id = year_3_semester_a..year_4_semester_b (8 semesters, no others).

TAU engineering regulations (Terms_BA.pdf p1, p13): a student may extend the degree by one more year with the teaching committee's approval (further extension in exceptional cases); a pregnancy/parenthood-eligible student may extend by up to 2 semesters without extension fees. The boards have no semester beyond year 4.

params.satisfied_by: attending the prerequisite course and being eligible for its exam

course_rules.note: TAU engineering regulations (Terms_BA.pdf p1): a prerequisite (קורס קדם) is taken before or in parallel with the course; meeting it means attending the prerequisite and being eligible for its exam (not passing it). The board records carry prerequisite data but no planner check applies this before-or-parallel semantics.

params.rule: no course of a later program year before completing every course of the current year and meeting the prerequisites

course_rules.note: TAU engineering regulations (Terms_BA.pdf p2, registration item 6): a student cannot register for courses of an advanced year without finishing all the courses of the current year and meeting the prerequisites. The boards place courses by year but do not block a later-year course while current-year courses are open.

requires: high grade average set by the teaching committee

course_rules.note: TAU engineering regulations (Terms_BA.pdf p2): an undergraduate may take graduate courses only with a high average and the track head's approval, and never more than two graduate courses per semester. The boards do not model graduate courses or this cap.

params.rule: may take the advanced course (course and exam) conditionally until the prerequisite course obligations are completed

course_rules.note: TAU engineering regulations (Terms_BA.pdf p11, p13): a student kept by reserve duty, or a pregnancy/parenthood-eligible student, from completing a prerequisite course may take the advanced course conditionally until the prerequisite is completed. Neither the spec nor the board models these statuses.
